tags.feature: 🏎️ [b]New Race Car[/b]: A brand-new exotic, AWD supercar. Lambo vibes with sharp handling and raw speed. Try it out!
🚨 [b]Police Chase Improvements[/b]: Police chases are now less punishing! If the police slow you down, they lose momentum and power. Making it easier to escape.
🧠 [b]Smarter AI Racers[/b]: Opponents now handle corners more intelligently for a more competitive race experience.
🛫 [b]Ramp Shortcuts[/b]: Ramps now launch you along predefined paths, turning them into real shortcuts you can use to your advantage.
